name: v6-e-curriculum-v2
note: V6 iteration 3. Failure loop on the development tasks (dev + unseen-v1; experiments/v6/failure_loop.py): 68% of round 54's clean failures misunderstand the prompt (they write another known function), 16% are incorrect logic. Changed variable vs D: the curriculum content (idioms-v2) - 19 multi-step algorithm families added; plausible-but-wrong repairs (the task's docstring over a sibling program's body, fixed to the program; 1 per program) aimed at the dominant failure; worked input-output examples with a boundary case in 40% of write prompts; 3 write + 1 bug-fix examples per program (~150k curriculum tokens vs D's ~129k). Budget, legacy share and recipe as D.
decision: Same pre-registered rule as v6-c-idioms: replaces round 54 only if every seed beats its all_clean (29/168), the mean gain is >= 3 items, and no category loses >= 3 clean items round 54 passes. unseen-v2 is the fixed holdout: never trained on, never used to choose between experiments. The benchmark is reported only.
